faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Ram Lal Anand College Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Guest Faculty post is 21 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Guest Faculty position in Computer Science.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online for the Ram Lal Anand College Guest Faculty recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria are as prescribed for regular Assistant Professor in Colleges of the University of Delhi in accordance with UGC regulations.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: The selection process includes the preparation of a Merit List and a Panel in order of merit.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.answer: The job type for this Guest Faculty position is contractual.

faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is RLAC/Notice/2026/71.
